rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who seems learned or scholar-like.

example.english: They are really scholarly and know a little about everything.
example.traditional: 佢真係好有學問，乜嘢都識少少。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hok6 man6 mat1 je5 dou1 sik1 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Use this for someone whose type, manner, or appearance is distinctly that of a scholar.

example.english: They look very scholarly and are always tucked away reading in the library.
example.traditional: 佢個樣好學者型，成日匿喺圖書館睇書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 hok6 ze2 jing4 seng4 jat6 nei1 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 tai2 syu1

rows.note: Use this mainly for writing, discussion, or other work that has an academic character.

example.english: This article is too scholarly for general readers to understand.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章太學術性，一般讀者未必睇得明。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 taai3 hok6 seot6 sing3 jat1 bun1 duk6 ze2 mei6 bit1 tai2 dak1 ming4
